verdict.rationale: Linear documents a public GraphQL API, which it says is the same one it uses internally, with an introspectable endpoint and published schema. The docs also cover a no-login Apollo Studio explorer, personal API keys and OAuth2, webhooks with a webhookCreate mutation, a typed TypeScript SDK, published rate limits and a deprecation policy. Agent-specific developer docs (delegation, mentions, app scopes) extend this to AI-driven use. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented, since no community or probe evidence in the pack addresses it.
